summary.intent: Refine and release a set of changes to the wisp-plugins (review-slop evaluation work: fix-pass entry, verification rules, description trim) while keeping scope strictly to the plugins and avoiding over-engineering.
summary.outcome: Scope was clarified (no edits to Callisto/Caliper/Monokl repos) and the user agreed to prune low-value scripts. The unused replay fixtures and paired-analysis tool with their tests were removed, the rule-owner test was kept, the evaluation doc was updated, checks were run and the cleanup was committed locally.

repo: Work lives in wisp-plugins on branch worktree-review-slop-evaluation (worktree at .claude/worktrees/review-slop-evaluation); `just check` runs the test suite (71 tests before cleanup).

Runtime prompts/references/harness shrank net 111 lines (+222/-333) and description text fell 51% (41,217 to 20,100 chars); tooling, tests, fixtures and the evaluation doc are non-runtime and not loaded by agents.
Kept tools: transcript-metrics.py and entire-findings.py for the re-measure; removed paired-analysis.py and the fix-pass-misses.json replay fixtures.
Per-project CI commands (`just ci`) for Monokl, Callisto and Caliper were read-only lookups; Callisto's `just ci` is a strict subset of GitHub CI and Caliper's was not checked against its workflow.
Open B10 item: make plugin.json the single source for the Codex manifest version to remove a manual release edit.

friction: The user was confused about why the work appeared to touch the tools' repos (Callisto, Caliper, Monokl); the AGENTS.md snippet and per-project command table blurred the plugin-only scope.
A safety classifier stopped the transcript read for the R2 identical-constitution-block question, so it was dropped.
The shell guard refused a combined delete/update/check command, so it had to be split into plain steps.
The user pushed back twice on scope: 'over-engineering' and 'not getting crazy', which led to some back-and-forth about what to cut.
open_items: Release versions undecided: smith minor, muse minor or major, the rest patch.
Push the branch (one local commit ahead of origin, plus the cleanup commit) and open the PR; trail #238 is waiting on the review.
R2 (identical-constitution-block cache question) remains open; `/usage` cache-read ratio could settle it.
Schema workstream deferred: a validator, retiring eight dead schema files, and the `reasoning` field.
Deferred: muse folding into scribe, scripting estimator/review-preprocessor/release-summarizer, and the regexes, until the PR is reviewed and the new path is used on real work.
AGENTS.md snippet and the Callisto/Caliper CI parity gap remain unresolved; the snippet for other repos is out of scope for now.
B10 (Codex manifest version from plugin.json) not yet done.
The evaluation doc is still long (about 282 lines before the update) and should not grow.
